Kairali Ayurvedic Group’s flagship ayurvedic destination, Kairali-The Ayurvedic Healing Village, Palakkad, Kerala is one-of-its-kind of a holistic space, which heals you internally and externally with traditional and authentic Ayurvedic therapies, treatments and medications along with Yoga and Meditation. Why an Alcohol Free retreat?

Ayurveda, the ancient science of life, emphasizes that what we consume directly affects our physical, mental, and emotional well-being. Alcohol is known to:

Disrupting the body’s detoxification processes
Weakening the digestive fire (Agni) and thereby causing imbalances
To cloud mental clarity, promote fatigue and emotional instability
Impairing the body’s ability to absorb the healing effects of Ayurvedic therapies and herbal applications

By abstaining from alcohol during your stay, your body and mind can experience deep rejuvenation and transformation.

A place for true healing and detoxification

Our resort offers a caring environment where guests can fully focus on their wellness journey. Whether you’re coming for a Panchakarma detox, stress relief, weight loss, or simply to relax, a clean, alcohol-free environment ensures your body receives the best possible regenerative benefits.

Non-smoking area to ensure clean air and a toxic-free atmosphere
Caffeine-free retreat to promote natural energy and mental clarity
Organic vegetarian retreat to support optimal health and digestion
Experience Ayurveda in its purest form

Kairali invites you to live an Ayurvedic lifestyle that benefits your body, mind, and soul. Free yourself from toxins, reset your system, and discover the true power of holistic healing in a tranquil, alcohol-free environment.

THE PROGRAMME
Process Involved In Ayurveda Training Program

The Ayurveda Training Program at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is a comprehensive and immersive experience that introduces participants to the principles and practices of ancient Ayurveda. The process is meticulously designed to balance theoretical knowledge with practical application, ensuring holistic understanding and skill development.

01

Initial Orientation: The program begins with an orientation session to familiarize participants with the core concepts of Ayurveda, including its history, philosophy, and applications. Participants are introduced to the three doshas (Vata, Pitta, and Kapha) and their role in maintaining health.

02

Theory Sessions: In-depth classroom-style sessions cover topics such as: Ayurvedic anatomy and physiology, Basics of herbal medicine and Ayurvedic formulations, Principles of diet and lifestyle management.

03

Practical Training: Hands-on practice includes learning various Ayurvedic therapies like: Abhyanga (oil massage), Shirodhara (pouring warm oil on the forehead), Panchakarma (detoxification techniques), Participants also engage in preparing herbal remedies and Ayurvedic dishes to understand the practical applications of theoretical knowledge.

04

Yoga & Meditation Integration: To enhance learning, yoga and meditation are incorporated into the daily routine. These practices align with Ayurveda’s emphasis on mind-body harmony.

05

Personalized Feedback: Instructors provide regular feedback to ensure participants grasp the techniques correctly and refine their skills for effective implementation.

◆
Comprehensive Curriculum & Expert Faculty: Our program offers a broad Ayurvedic curriculum taught by seasoned practitioners, ensuring a well-rounded education.

THE PROGRAMME
Process Involved In Ayurveda Training Program

The Ayurveda Training Program at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is a comprehensive and immersive experience that introduces participants to the principles and practices of ancient Ayurveda. The process is meticulously designed to balance theoretical knowledge with practical application, ensuring holistic understanding and skill development.

01

Initial Orientation: The program begins with an orientation session to familiarize participants with the core concepts of Ayurveda, including its history, philosophy, and applications. Participants are introduced to the three doshas (Vata, Pitta, and Kapha) and their role in maintaining health.

02

Theory Sessions: In-depth classroom-style sessions cover topics such as: Ayurvedic anatomy and physiology, Basics of herbal medicine and Ayurvedic formulations, Principles of diet and lifestyle management.

03

Practical Training: Hands-on practice includes learning various Ayurvedic therapies like: Abhyanga (oil massage), Shirodhara (pouring warm oil on the forehead), Panchakarma (detoxification techniques), Participants also engage in preparing herbal remedies and Ayurvedic dishes to understand the practical applications of theoretical knowledge.

04

Yoga & Meditation Integration: To enhance learning, yoga and meditation are incorporated into the daily routine. These practices align with Ayurveda’s emphasis on mind-body harmony.

05

Personalized Feedback: Instructors provide regular feedback to ensure participants grasp the techniques correctly and refine their skills for effective implementation.

Past Retreats
Historical retreat description

A week of complete rest and revitalization. Reconnect with your inner self via yoga and meditation. Nurture your body with Ayurvedic massages and therapies. Feed your stomach with tasty vegetarian dishes!

We rise to the melody of birds and begin the day with a hatha yoga session. What finer method to invigorate both body and mind! We then enjoy a tasty vegetarian breakfast from South India. The day consists of ayurvedic therapies and lots of leisure time to reflect and appreciate the serene green landscape nearby. Enjoy a swim, take a stroll, or just read a book on the terrace of your exclusive villa! Next, we enjoy lunch and a possible second treatment, and the day concludes with another yoga session. In the evening, we have our meal and occasionally come together for a brief satsanga.

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is located within 65 acres of verdant surroundings in Palakkad, Kerala. It boasts 30 exclusive villas, all designed according to “Vastu Shastra” architecture – the Indian equivalent of feng shui. This indicates that they each possess a unique design, harmonizing with the environment and encircled by plants and trees known for their significant healing and rejuvenating abilities.

Mantra chanting
A proper introduction to the meaning and method of mantra chanting.
Village Walk
Guided walk through the nearby village and temple

Note: This does not include travel arrangements (flight tickets and airport transportation)

Teacher

Lakshya is a certified Yoga teacher, having more than 7 years of experience and practice in Hatha Yoga. She has studied yoga extensively in India and has also completed a 3-year course in Vedanta, Sanskrit, and Vedic Chanting under the tutelage of her Guru, Swami Dayananda Saraswati, in Coimbatore, India.

Lakshya’s classes are dynamic in nature, focusing on breath and movement synchronization and allowing students to explore their own capacities. She shows practitioners from all levels how to tap into their inner joy and sense of well-being. For Lakshya, Yoga is more than just a practice- it is a way of life. About the Villa

The Royal Villa delivers an exceptional fusion of elegance and authenticity at a surprisingly affordable price range, living up to its regal moniker. World-renowned interior designers have skillfully created these lodgings, which draw inspiration from medieval Indian palaces, to create an ambiance of calm and polished elegance.

Guests can live the kind of life that was previously only available to nobles within these walls, complete with opulent furnishings and first-rate amenities. The design of the villa creates a special haven where traditional wellness meets contemporary indulgence by skillfully fusing opulent comfort with the principles of Ayurvedic life

Each Royal Villa features:

◆
Expertly curated, high-end furniture
◆
Premium quality construction materials
◆
State-of-the-art facilities
◆
Thoughtfully selected amenities for maximum comfort

The capacity of these villas to provide a truly royal experience at an incredibly low cost is what makes them unique. The splendor of aristocratic living is available to visitors without the imperial price tag, making this high-end lifestyle experience affordable for anyone looking for both luxury and good value.

The Royal Villa is an example of well-considered design, with each element working together to create a space that fulfills everyone’s need for upscale living while preserving the tranquil environment necessary for Ayurvedic treatment procedures. It offers guests a genuinely remarkable experience that epitomizes royal hospitality by perfectly combining historical grandeur with modern comfort.

“Step into a world of regal opulence and let the enchanting ambiance of our Royal Villa captivate your senses. With its spacious layout and impeccable attention to detail, this villa offers a truly immersive experience, where Ayurvedic healing meets luxurious indulgence.“
